transcript.t: Lily, the freestyle final starts now!
Which lane is our school's swimmer in?
Lane four. He is wearing the red cap.
Oh no, he is behind at the turn.
Do not worry. He is catching up with the leader.
Go! The whole crowd is cheering.
He took the lead! He won by half a second!
What a dramatic finish! He also set a new school record. Let's congratulate him after the ceremony.
